mapper.select: select a.id as id,a.username as username,a.truename as truename, a.`password` as `password`,a.email as email,a.phone as phone, a.add_date as create_date,a.expire_date as expire_date,a.add_by as creator, a.enabled as enabled,case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 then 0 else a.field_id end as fieldId, case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 or b.field_name is null then '全部题库' else b.field_name end as fieldName, a.last_login_time as lastLoginTime, a.login_time as loginTime,department from et_user a left join et_field b on a.field_id=b.field_id where id=#{id}

select a.id as id,a.username as username,a.truename as truename, a.`password` as `password`,a.email as email,a.phone as phone, a.add_date as create_date,a.expire_date as expire_date,a.add_by as creator, a.enabled as enabled,case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 then 0 else a.field_id end as fieldId, case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 or b.field_name is null then '全部题库' else b.field_name end as fieldName,a.last_login_time as lastLoginTime, a.login_time as loginTime,department from et_user a left join et_field b on a.field_id=b.field_id where username=#{username}

select a.id as id,a.username as username,a.truename as truename, a.`password` as `password`,a.email as email,a.phone as phone, a.add_date as create_date,a.expire_date as expire_date,b.username as creator,case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 then '全部题库' else (select field_name from et_field where field_id=a.field_id) end as fieldName, a.enabled as enabled,department from et_user a LEFT JOIN et_user b on a.add_by=b.id order by a.id

select a.id as id,a.username as username,a.truename as truename, a.`password` as `password`,a.email as email,a.phone as phone, a.add_date as create_date,a.expire_date as expire_date, (select username from et_user m where m.id=a.add_by) as creator,case when a.field_id is null or a.field_id = 0 then '全部题库' else (select field_name from et_field where field_id=a.field_id) end as fieldName, a.enabled as enabled,department from et_user a,et_r_user_role b where a.id=b.user_id and b.role_id=#{role_id}
select c.* from et_user a,et_r_user_role b,et_role c where a.id=b.user_id and b.role_id=c.id and a.id=#{user_id} order by c.name
